description: Connect to {domain}:{port} over TLS and return the leaf certificate + full chain: subject, issuer, validity dates, days remaining, fingerprint (SHA-256), subject alternative names, signature algorithm, negotiated protocol and cipher. Useful for verifying a domain has HTTPS, the cert is not expired, and the chain is properly configured. SSRF-protected: refuses private/loopback/link-local/cloud-metadata IPs. 5s connect timeout.
name: ssl_check
